name: Sinofert Holdings Limited
summary: Sinofert Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the production, import and export, distribution, and retail of fertilizer raw materials and crop nutrition products in Mainland China and internationally. The company operates through Basic Business, Growth Business, and Production segments. It offers potash; phosphate; bio-compound fertilizers; special and nitrogen fertilizers; sulfur, crop protection, and seeds; and monocalcium and dicalcium phosphate. The company also provides technological research and development, and services relating to crop nutrition business and products; trades in fertilizers; develops agriculture products; and manufactures and sells feeds.
